{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.}} The '''Snipetron''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} built sniper rifle. Its high focus on {{D|Puncture}} damage makes it an ideal weapon for use against Corpus and Orokin targets. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +25% headshot damage. **Second zoom has 6.0x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. *Innate 2.5 meter [[punch through]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Inaccurate beyond short range when fired from the hip. }} {{WeaponComparison|Snipetron Vandal}} ==Acquisition== The blueprint occasionally returns as an offering sold by [[Nakak]] in [[Cetus]] during the [[Operation: Plague Star]] event for {{sc|3,000}} [[Operational Supply]] and {{cc|5,000}}. The blueprint is available from [[Ticker]] in [[Fortuna]] during the [[Star Days]] event for 8 {{Resource|Advances Debt-Bond}}s. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Using {{M|Wildfire}} and {{M|Magazine Warp}} on their own will give you one bullet each, while using both at the same time will give you two extra bullets. *Originally the Snipetron was available from the [[Market]], but it was retired since {{ver|8}} due to lore issues where the Corpus do not utilize weapons that fire bullets, but rely on [[Lanka|energy weapons]] or [[Railgun MOA|railgun technology]]. *Players were previously able to obtain a {{Weapon|Snipetron Vandal}} and a [[Blueprint]] for the normal Snipetron through the [[Informant Event]] after killing 20 [[Informer]]s. The developers admitted that this was an apology for the Snipetron's sudden removal. Following the event, any piece of content to be removed from the market is now given a week's advance notice. *The Snipetron blueprint was added as a reward for the Project Undermine [[Tactical Alert]] from the 2nd of October 2015 to the 5th of October 2015. ==Tips== *Use your melee or your sidearm for close-quarters combat. **The {{Weapon|Bronco}} ([[:Bronco Prime|Prime]]), {{Weapon|Akbronco}} ([[:Akbronco Prime|Prime]]), {{Weapon|Brakk}}, {{Weapon|Euphona Prime}}, {{Weapon|Twin Rogga}}, and {{Weapon|Detron}} ([[:Mara Detron|Mara]]) all make for an excellent complement to the Snipetron, covering close range battles where the Snipetron suffers. *As a general note, ammo consumption should not be too big of an issue as long as players make full use of their abilities and melee weapons in conjunction with Snipetron. *Use the {{M|Sniper Ammo Mutation}} mod to greatly relieve the low total ammo and ammo drop chance for sniper rifles. **Alternatively, bring [[Squad Ammo Restore]] or use Carrier's {{M|Ammo Case}}. *Like all sniper rifles, the Snipetron works well with Warframes with mobility-boosting abilities such as {{WF|Zephyr}} or {{WF|Nova}}. ==Trivia== *As this was the first true sniper rifle in the game, [[Grineer]] [[Ballista]] were equipped with this weapon before the {{Weapon|Vulkar}} was introduced. *The Snipetron shares an identical appearance with the {{Weapon|Lanka}}, which effectively replaced it as the Corpus sniper rifle. ==Media== Snipetron.jpg CorpusSnipe.jpg|The scope overlay used by the Snipetron and other Corpus-made sniper rifle. Snipetron_(1).png|Snipetron when equipped in the arsenal Snipetron_(2).png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|leLC2Xwfusk|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|c6IGGxNcXq8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Cj-NUSnDiJ0|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|uuSoGrvlpbM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|OAb2TU3c-as|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. {{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.}} The '''Snipetron Vandal''' is the [[Vandal]] version of the {{Weapon|Snipetron}}, sporting an increase in magazine size and reload speed, but sacrifices {{D|Impact}} and {{D|Slash}} damages in order to boost its {{D|Puncture}} damage. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}} ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +30% headshot damage. **Second zoom has 6.0x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage, making it ideal for long-range combat. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. *Innate 3 meter [[punch through]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *High [[recoil]]. *Inaccurate beyond short range when fired from the hip. }} {{WeaponComparison|Snipetron}} ==Acquisition== This weapon's blueprint and parts can currently be found as [[Invasion]] rewards. Previously, this weapon was awarded as a special-edition reward for killing 20 [[Informer]]s in the [[Informant Event]], complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]]. The blueprint and parts were also formerly a reward from the [[Sortie/ArchivedRewards|Sixth Season]] of [[Sortie]]s. All components can be [[Trade System|traded]], although players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 5 to acquire the blueprint. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *The Snipetron Vandal requires 3 shots to activate its shot combo counter, giving it a 1.5x damage bonus on the third shot, a 2.0x damage bonus after 9 shots, and a 2.5x damage bonus after 27 shots. {| class="wikitable" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:center;border:1px solid black;width:80%;font-size:12px;" |- ! scope="col" |Combo Counter Bonus Tier ! scope="col" |Total Base Damage Multiplier ! scope="col" |Minimum Consecutive Hits Required |- |1 || 1.5x || 3 |- |2 || 2.0x || 9 |- |3 || 2.5x || 27 |- |4 || 3.0x || 81 |- |5 || 3.5x || 243 |- |6 || 4.0x || 729 |- |7 || 4.5x || 2187 |- |8 || 5.0x || 6561 |} ==Tips== *While there are ''significantly ''more high-powered snipers, this (and the original Snipetron) is the only {{D|Puncture}}-based weapon in this category. *When aiming, try to line up your shot before zooming, then zoom, adjust for error, and fire. This may take some practice, but it's much easier and faster than firing from the hip or zooming haphazardly. *Carry a good melee or close-range sidearm to engage foes at close range, since the Snipetron Vandal is inefficient and difficult to use properly at this distance. *As a general note, ammo consumption should not be problematic, provided players make full use of their abilities and melee weapons in conjunction with Snipetron Vandal. *With maximized {{M|Split Chamber}} and {{M|Point Strike}} you have a 48.44% chance of landing one critical hit, with a 35.16% chance to land 2 critical hits and a 16.41% chance to not land a critical hit at all. *Use the {{M|Sniper Ammo Mutation}} mod to greatly relieve the low total ammo and ammo drop chance for sniper rifles. Alternatively, bring [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s or use Carrier's {{M|Ammo Case}}. ==Media== CorpusSnipe.jpg|This is what the zoom-HUD looks like in [[Corpus]] Snipers. {{Codex|While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.}}

The '''Spectra''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} handheld cutting laser that is as effective at cutting flesh as it is at cutting metal. It is essentially a sidearm version of the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}.

This weapon can be sold for {{cc|5,000}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*Damage ramps up from 25% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 25% over 2 seconds.
*Innate 0.5 meter [[punch through]].
*Can use the Spectra-exclusive {{M|Sequence Burn}} mod.

{{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
**{{M|Magnum Force}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
*Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held|
*Limited range of 18 meters.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Spectra Vandal}}

==Acquisition==
The Spectra's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Tips==
*As with the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}, multishot mods (in this case {{M|Barrel Diffusion}}) are essential to maximize output. {{M|Lethal Torrent}} can be used to further increase damage.
**Increasing the fire rate with Lethal Torrent will drastically increase ammo consumption.
*Using the {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} mod can help regain lost ammo when needed. Alternatively, use {{M|Pistol Scavenger}} Aura or bring along [[Squad Ammo Restore]].
*Similar building with the Flux Rifle, adding {{M|Magnum Force}} to the Spectra can actually be beneficial, as the shooter does not require precise aiming. This will further reduce its medium range effectiveness however. 
*{{M|Ruinous Extension}} and {{M|Sequence Burn}} can bring up the Spectra's range to rival those of Primary beam weapons.

==Trivia==
*The Spectra is currently known to be one of the most improved weapons throughout the game's patches, as it was one of the weakest [[Clan Dojo]] [[Research]] weaponry ever released: It used to deal a total of 8 damage per second.
*Spectra is the plural form of [[wikipedia:Spectrum|Spectrum]].
*During the final phases of the Arid Fear event, the [[Scout|Corpus Scouts]] were equipped with Spectras, which they would use for short durations before attempting to run.
*Ceasing fire from the Spectra actually retracts the beam instead of it disappearing.

{{Codex|Accuracy combined with a massive magazine make the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.}}

The '''Soma''' is a {{Faction|Tenno}} assault rifle with very high critical potential, very high [[fire rate]] that is achieved after a spool-up period, and a large magazine capacity. Its lackluster base damage is largely supported by its incredible critical stats, making the Soma a deceivingly powerful rifle. Coupled with its sustainable fire rate, the Soma is suitable for any distance engagement.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*Requires a spool-up of '''6''' shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
** Fire rate starts at '''25%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''15%''' per shot.

{{Advantages|name=Soma|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Soma|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Soma Prime}}

==Acquisition==
The Soma's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}.

==Notes==
*This weapon can be treated like an upgraded {{Weapon|Grakata}}, due to its higher [[critical chance]], lower recoil and a larger magazine size. Although the spin-up time, slower maximum fire rate and much lower status chance must also be taken into account.
*Capable of shooting the first shot of the magazine with high accuracy, allowing shots to weak-points from afar.
*The Soma is able to cut enemy corpses, ideal for use with a [[Desecrate|Desecrating]] {{WF|Nekros}} or for low to medium level enemies.

==Incarnon Genesis==
{{Transclude|Soma Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}}

{{Transclude|Soma Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}}

==Tips ==

*{{M|Rifle Ammo Mutation}} can help regain lost ammunition if the user has ammo conservation problems or if the Soma is unranked, but leaves less room for damage mods, Alternatively, use {{M|Rifle Scavenger}} or [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s. Using Carrier's [[Ammo Case]] is also a viable method.
*Firing in bursts helps with ammo consumption. When well-modded, the Soma is capable of dispatching many common enemies with 1 or 2 shots.
* The Soma's [[critical chance]] can be boosted up to 75% with a maximum-rank {{M|Point Strike}}.
*With a maximum rank {{M|Vital Sense}} and a {{M|Hammer Shot}} mod, the Soma's [[critical multiplier]] can be increased to 8.4x.
*Once the weapon is fully-spooled, some skills (like {{A|Iron Skin}}) may be activated without losing the firing speed.
*Similarly, it retains its fast firing rate if you stop firing for short periods. This lets the wielder change targets without wasting large amounts of ammunition in between separate enemies, as long as they do so quickly. This can also be used to keep tighter firing spreads at long ranges, essentially "bursting" rounds with quick pauses between to reduce recoil.
*The Soma's magazine is reloaded before the reload animation actually finishes, as little as halfway through the animation itself. Thus, canceling the reload animation still counts as a reload, essentially cutting the reload time by half.
*This weapon has a slight wind up time, much like the {{Weapon|Gorgon}} (only less prominent). This can be taken advantage of by tapping the fire button, making it fire single bullets at a time, which can be effective for sniping weaker units.
*The significantly tighter spread at long range gives the Soma an advantage over the Gorgon and Supra for picking off heavy units, but the latter two are more effective at clearing large groups of enemies.

==Trivia==

* The magazine curls up into the weapon while firing, and ejects when ammo is depleted.
**If reloaded with an amount other than a full magazine in reserve, the magazine will snap to the ammunition remaining within the magazine as soon as the reload animation is finished.
*The Soma's design seems to be based on the French [[wikipedia:Chauchat|Chauchat]].
**Its unusual magazine shape resembles the Japanese [[wikipedia:Type 100 SMG|Type 100 SMG]], or the [[wikipedia:Type 99 light machine gun|Type 99 LMG]] when the magazine has gone through.
**The rigid moving magazine/clip is almost unique to fictional firearms. The [[wikipedia:Type_92_heavy_machine_gun|Type 92]]'s rigid feed strips and belt feeding closely resemble the Soma. Stripper clips, namely "[[wikipedia:Clip_(firearms)#En_bloc|en bloc clips]]" like in the [[wikipedia:M1_Garand|M1 Garand]], are perhaps the closest in terms of magazine/clip design.
*Another inspiration for the Soma's appearance could be pulled from the ever infamous [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AK-47 AK-47 assault rifle]. The shape of the Soma does not have the typical butt of the AK-47, but the notable "banana clip" is present, albeit exaggerated.

* The weapon's name is shared with the Hinduistic god, Soma, who is a being attributed with the Moon. The shape of its magazine could also be thought to share a resemblance to a moon's crescent.
**It also shares it's name with the Ancient Greek word for body (σῶμα), which might be related to the rifle's large size.
*The Soma's icon and its blueprint shows the magazine halfway depleted.
*Reloading the Soma will eject the magazine. Repeatedly reload-cancelling can leave a pile of Soma magazines on the floor.
*The Soma was described in the market as a "deadly and elegant high caliber Tenno assault rifle." Despite allegedly high caliber rounds, its damage is second to worst, and its magazine capacity is high compared with other weapons. Judging from the physical size of other weapons' magazines, it may be a ''relatively'' high caliber.
*The Soma initially had a Mastery Rank requirement of 3. This was increased to 6 in Update 10.5.
*In [[:File:The Profit - Warframe PS4 Launch Trailer|The Profit]], Volt is seen using the Soma but instead of the magazine curling up as it usually would, it curls downwards.
*During [[Livestream 14|Devstream 14]], Digital Extremes talked about increasing the weapon's Mastery Rank to suit the effectiveness of the Soma, rather than nerfing the weapon. This was implemented in {{ver|10.5}}.
* Prior to Update 11, the Soma had a [[critical chance]] of 35%. After Update 11 launched, the Soma's [[critical chance]] was decreased to 25%, then subsequently increased to 30%. Also, while the figures have officially not changed, anecdotal evidence from players state that the Soma's spread was loosened and recoil increased in Update 11, though it is still one of the most accurate assault rifles in the game.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Prisma Gorgon}}, {{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, {{Weapon|Telos Boltor}}, and {{Weapon|Tenora Prime}} for the second highest [[critical chance]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Battacor}} and {{Weapon|Acceltra}}.
*Tied with Soma Prime {{Weapon|Attica}}, and {{Weapon|Baza}}/{{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the highest [[critical multiplier]] of all fully automatic rifles.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Soma Prime}} for the second lowest base damage of all fully automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Grakata}}.

*The colored magazine removed from the Soma will return to its original color.
*There are several appearance bugs associated with the Soma's magazine. The magazine may get "stuck" if reload-cancelled right before the reload completes, leaving the Soma free for use without a magazine loaded.
*Occasionally, the user can find the Soma ejecting multiple magazines on a single reload.

* Sometimes the clip may be loaded backwards, with the bottom of the clip getting jammed into the barrel and cycling through the weapon counter-clockwise.
